exposure: fetal and/or maternal complications during pregnancy
cohort: 417 under-five children attending public health facilities of Dessie city, Ethiopia
finding: Gross motor developmental delay was significantly associated with increased child age, male sex, history of alcohol intake during pregnancy, fetal/maternal complications, and instrumental delivery, while increased gestational age and iron intake during pregnancy were protective.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery was significantly associated with gross motor developmental delay in under-five children.
